window.notes: The same EHZ-reload window as the raw-v1 driver-oracle fixture, carrying in addition the ordered pre-consumption request_transfers inventory observed before ROM PC 0x10D6 executes move.b D0,$09(A1,D1.w). Recaptured for the two-site observer: every transfer now carries an explicit site, and the music site observes the store at loc_10C0 (docs/s2disasm/s2.asm:1302-1304), which move.b D0,$09(A1,D1.w) at 0x10D6 never reaches. The capture is bounded to this window, so source_first_row and source_exclusive_end are the window's own bounds.

capture.duplicate_capture_gate: not applicable to this recapture: the payload is comparison-only reference data, republished from a single deterministic bounded capture whose attestation and capability digests are pinned here and in S2PublishedRequestWindows.
capture.capture_paths_note: Two distinct absent external paths under a session scratch root, outside the repository; recorded for provenance, not as a re-runnable location.

production_bound_meaning: The payload's own metadata line carries production_bound:false and that value is preserved verbatim. Publication under Task 8A's final bullet installs the reviewed capture as a committed comparison reference; it does not bind it to a production producer. The candidate reader stays package-private and CLI-unreachable, S2RequestAwareCandidateComparator remains a disposable test-only comparator, and request equality stays REFERENCE_LIMITATION until an independent authenticated OpenGGF producer observes equivalent source-owned evidence. Nothing here hydrates engine state: this fixture is comparison-only, MEASUREMENT_ONLY at the gate.
notes: Human approval for publication was granted on 2026-09-03 after the duplicate-capture gate was met (two independent captures, identical SHA-256).
